title: kb_backlog cuts its output at the facades' character cap
goal: kb_backlog cuts its text at FACADE_MAX_CHARS with the same pointer to the command line the facades print

run:
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import kb_mcp
t = kb_mcp.kb_backlog({'command': 'list', 'args': []})
print('kb_backlog list chars:', len(t)); sys.exit(0 if len(t) <= kb_mcp.FACADE_MAX_CHARS + 200 else 1)

clauses.clause: kb_backlog cuts its text at FACADE_MAX_CHARS with the same pointer to the command line the facades print
